name: TrustLLM
intro: TrustLLM是一项关于LLM可信度的综合研究，提出涵盖八个维度的可信原则，并基于此建立包含真诚性、安全性、公平性、鲁棒性、隐私及机器伦理等六个维度的评测基准。研究评估了16个主流LLM，涉及30多个数据集。

metric: Accuracy, F1, BLEU, ROUGE, Perplexity, LLM-as-Judge
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 分类, 生成
eval_feature: 多轮, 对抗性, 领域特定
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Classification, Generation
build_method_en: Hybrid, Human Annotation, Expert Curation, Web Crawling
intro_en: TrustLLM is a comprehensive study on LLM trustworthiness, proposing trust principles across eight dimensions and establishing an evaluation benchmark covering six dimensions: sincerity, safety, fairness, robustness, privacy, and machine ethics. The study assesses 16 mainstream LLMs using over 30 datasets.
metric_en: Accuracy, F1, BLEU, ROUGE, Perplexity, LLM-as-Judge

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TrustLLM arXiv:2401.05561, Sections 2-10 and Appendices; official HowieHwong/TrustLLM repository. TrustLLM first defines eight trustworthiness principles, then operationalizes the six dimensions that can be benchmarked reproducibly: truthfulness, safety, fairness, robustness, privacy, and machine ethics. The authors decompose these into more than 18 subcategories, select or construct over 30 datasets, standardize task prompts, and add controlled perturbations or adversarial cases where required. Sixteen representative LLMs are evaluated with dimension-specific procedures: exact or semantic correctness, refusal and toxicity behavior, group disparities, perturbation consistency, privacy leakage, and ethical-choice agreement. Metrics are normalized within their task context and summarized by subcategory, dimension, and overall model comparison; transparency and accountability remain principles but are not scored in this benchmark.
